ours.label: ours
statements: Provide effort estimates for upcoming project phases and product roadmap quarterly planning
Review AI-generated code
Attend daily standup meetings to discuss work status, project progress, and coordinate team efforts
Debug and fix software issues such as code errors, database problems, and bugs to improve stability or resolve user-reported issues
Document and update API documentation, including endpoints and request or response formats
Conduct meetings with clients or businesses to gather or clarify requirements and project constraints
Address feedback from reviews such as code or portfolio reviews
Mentor and teach junior engineers or apprentices to develop technical skills and support their growth
Attend retrospective meetings to evaluate project performance
Request reviews from team members to enhance collaboration and code quality
Coordinate with engineers to integrate APIs and establish API contracts
Test application functionality across devices or operating systems before release
Set up or maintain CI/CD pipelines for deployment, automated builds, and releases
Negotiate technical trade-offs with product owners or managers during planning or on scope
Review pull requests to ensure code quality and provide feedback
Implement new features or write code based on product or project requirements
Escalate unresolved technical blockers to senior staff or the appropriate team member
Prepare and share demos of new or completed features with stakeholders
Generate boilerplate code using AI coding assistants
Create or implement APIs to facilitate interactions or enable communication between systems
Monitor production errors and application logs after deployment or releases
Refactor backend code to improve readability, maintainability, and performance without changing intended behavior
Maintain infrastructure and system health to ensure stability and reliability
Respond to internal team queries via messaging platforms such as Slack or async channels
Triage and prioritize tickets such as bug reports, feature requests, or engineering issues
Attend planning sessions to align on project objectives
Write and update tests such as unit, integration, and automated tests for components and code
Generate working code drafts using AI assistance
Update ticket status and project status in task tracking tools such as Jira to reflect progress or implement changes
Review code
Deploy changes to production environments to implement updates or new features
Respond to and resolve production incidents or outages to restore services or functionality

onet.label: onet
statements: Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures, programming, or documentation.
Confer with stakeholders to obtain information on project limitations and capabilities
Modify existing software to correct errors, adapt it to new hardware, or upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
Prepare reports or correspondence concerning project specifications, activities, or status.
Analyze information to determine, recommend, and plan installation of a new system or modification of an existing system.
Store, retrieve, and manipulate data for analysis of system capabilities and requirements.
Design, develop and modify software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcomes and consequences of design.
Determine system performance standards.
Consult with customers or other departments on project status, proposals, or technical issues, such as software system design or maintenance.
Monitor functioning of equipment to ensure system operates in conformance with specifications.
Coordinate installation of software system.
Supervise the work of programmers, technologists, technicians, and other engineering or scientific personnel
Obtain and evaluate information on factors such as reporting formats required, costs, or security needs to determine hardware configuration.
Train users to use new or modified equipment.
